Most isps use cgnat.. CGNAT (Carrier-Grade Network Address Translation) is a large-scale technique Internet Service Providers (ISPs) use to share a limited pool of public IPv4 addresses among many customers, letting thousands of users share one public IP by assigning them private IPs and managing translations at the ISP level, extending IPv4's life but complicating direct connections like port forwarding.
